items.title: Constructible subsets of a Noetherian space are open in the constructible topology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a constructible subset of a Noetherian topological space is open in the constructible topology (author lemma at source lines 3163-3174, label lemma-constructible-neighbourhood-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 3176-3197) decomposes the subset into finitely many locally closed pieces and observes that each of them is open in the constructible topology (proof lines 3176-3196). The decomposition and the case check are the content. H3.
